prerequisites: Basic knowledge of information technology at university level
Positive completion of the StEOP (Study Entrance and Orientation Phase)

learning_outcomes.text: Master basic concepts of IT systems that comprehensively and integratively support production processes of industrial companies.
Operate standard software systems in an industrial environment.
Understand the field of Industrial Information Systems as an interdisciplinary competence for students from mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, or process engineering.
Confidently apply standard software systems such as ERP systems in an industrial environment.
Understand and determine the functionality and possibilities of these systems and Smart Technologies.
Execute logistics processes using appropriate IT tools.
Demonstrate practical skills in operating relevant IT systems.
Design necessary processes and data structures.
Analyze and determine requirements for given problem or task definitions.
Design suitable IT architectures to cover requirements.
Design the introduction or expansion of industrial information systems based on the architecture and the above knowledge.
Select individual tools for use in the architecture.
Design and implement the adaptation and extension of systems to company-specific conditions.
Design project management and lead a project.
Explain the fundamentals of industrial information systems as an interdisciplinary competence, among other things.
Discuss contributions in lectures and exercises based on facts.
Process software functionalities in case studies in a structured manner within a team.
Confidently use the e-learning platform for communication, material retrieval, and submissions.
Plan work processes, schedules, and milestones for the exercise and implementation in companies in a goal-oriented manner.
Clearly distinguish requirements and assumptions in case studies.
Present results and documentation in an audience-appropriate manner.

syllabus_topics: Implementation Projects for Industrial Information Systems
teaching_methods: Exercise with support from staff and tutors
Independent work on software functionalities using case studies
